title: AI Research Intern
description:
TLDR: Davis AI is hiring an AI Research Intern to push further and scale our state-of-the-art floorplan generation model. Image-based models produce plans that break building codes under scrutiny; ours works on structure, not pixels, and is already beating all the benchmarks. You will be joining the tech team and, alongside architects, you will run falsifiable ablations on our discrete diffusion model, improve training, conditioning, and sampling at multi-GPU scale, and build the vision pipeline that turns raw plans into training data.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Our Mission

We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan.

The Role

We are looking for an AI Research Engineer intern to spearhead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about pushing the state-of-the-art in generative models and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools. You will work within a focused team of 3 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architecture experts to turn foundational research into deployable tools.

What you'll be working on:

  • Model Architecture & Design Space exploration: Take an open question about the model and answer it properly. Read the literature, form a hypothesis, design the ablation that can actually falsify it, run it, and make sense of what you found.

  • Model improvement: Improve our SOTA model. That means training runs on multi-GPU nodes, reading loss curves and generated samples, and iterating on architecture, loss design, conditioning, and sampling.

  • Dataset creation: Training data is the single biggest lever on output quality. The work is building the agentic pipeline that produces it automatically, a computer vision problem at its core: parsing raster plans, PDFs and scans into a clean, consistent structured representation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Applied Research Excellence: Currently in a top MSc/PhD (or equivalent) in ML, CS, applied maths, or a closely related field.

  • Diffusion Model Expertise: Strong understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.

  • Technical Engineering Skills: Strong programmer in Python with experience in PyTorch. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.

  • Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills. Able to articulate complex concepts clearly and work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and domain experts to integrate technical solutions into the architectural design workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Experience : Former internship in Diffusion or generative modelling

  • Publications/Open Source: Research publications in generative modeling (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs) or significant open-source contributions demonstrating ability to push state-of-the-art systems.

  • Domain Knowledge: While not required, an interest in architecture or design will help.

  • Reinforcement Learning & Optimization: Experience with RL, reward modeling, or constrained optimization (particularly MCTS, GRPO and RLHF) relevant to guiding generative models under complex constraints.

  • Multimodal Generation: Experience with graph-based, sequence-based, or discrete structured generative models (e.g., molecule generation, layout generation, program synthesis) or with graph neural networks.

  • Computer Vision: Experience with document and structured-image understanding, such as VLMs, OCR and layout parsing, vectorization, or segmentation and detection pipelines applied to plans, diagrams or CAD-like sources.

  • Agentic Systems: Experience building LLM agent pipelines — tool use, multi-step workflows, prompt optimization frameworks (DSPy, GEPA) — and the evaluation harnesses needed to make them reliable at scale.

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • Work on meaningful challenges: from constraint-aware generative models to real-world deployment in major construction projects.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • Ship fast, iterate boldly: go from research to prototype to production in weeks, not years.

  • Join a world-class team: a mix of AI researchers, engineers, and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why we'll win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

Requirements • Autonomy: We’re looking for someone who can work independently with minimal guidance or oversight. • Attention to Detail: You are thorough and accurate when reading, interpreting and performing tasks. • Client Relations/Customer Service: You enjoy providing great service to our customers. • Communication: You are fluent in English, and can effectively listen and share knowledge and information with others. You communicate effectively, both in written and oral forms, using proper spelling and grammar. Most support is provided in writing (Intercom messenger and email), so it is very important that you are skilled in written communication with our customers. • Problem-Solving Skills: You use critical thinking skills to work through the details of a problem to reach a solution. • Resourcefulness: You can creatively handle new situations or difficulties skillfully and promptly. • Taking Initiative + Self-Driven: You can see an opportunity or need and act upon it without being asked or told. We expect the workload to be approximately 35-40 hours per week. • Must be available to work primarily during business hours in the Pacific time zone (e.g. Monday - Friday 9a-5p Pacific time), with occasional coverage on Saturdays. • Must be authorized to work in the United States. Benefits • USD $27/hour • Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) • Participation in retirement plan with company match • Fully remote position Required Education and Experience • Minimum formal education of high school diploma or GED. • Intermediate computer knowledge a must, including the use of web applications in general, and understanding web technology from an end-user’s perspective. • Ability to independently learn and implement new technologies quickly. Preferred Education and Experience • Previous experience handling technical support for a SaaS company • Ability to speak Spanish fluently (not required, but would be considered a plus for the officials we support who do not speak English) To Apply We will only accept applications through our online job application form . Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. For questions, please contact us at jobs@assignr.com. No phone calls, please. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/assignr-llc-customer-support-specialist-2

Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: AI Deployment Strategist
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI solutions, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, ensuring our customers achieve transformative outcomes.

 

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to customer success, bridging the gap between strategy and execution.

 

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex business challenges, and are passionate about turning AI potential into real-world impact.

 

What You Will Do

 

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

• Lead executive-level workshops to identify business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step-change improvements.

• Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value.

• Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives.

 

AI Solution Design & Deployment

• Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer workflows and technical infrastructure.

• Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

• Own the execution of pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

 

Value Realization & Customer Success

• Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

• Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product and research roadmaps.

• Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence.

• Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

• 2+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g., data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales).

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

• Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value.

• Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions.

• Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level).

• Hands on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python)

• Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

• Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC) and value-based selling is a plus.

 

Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

 
 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Big Bear Vacations: Owner Retention Specialist
description: Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/ OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico Reports To: Director of Owner Relations Employment Type: Contractor Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required Position Purpose The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta. This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes. The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication. The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up. Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages. Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business. Core Responsibilities 1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication • Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text. • Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model. • Maintain a balance across the three touch types: • Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content. • Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem. • Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook. • Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step. • Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day. • Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer. • Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners. 2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates • Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports. • Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate. • Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines. • Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders. • Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval. • Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person. • Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property. 3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification • Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies. • Escalate concerns on the same business day. • Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop. • Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person. • Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate. 4. Documentation & CRM Discipline • Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs. • Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis. • Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day. • Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off. • Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified. • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications. Daily Operating Rhythm Start of Day • Log into RingCentral and Monday.com. • Review the Owner Engagement Tracker. • Identify owners due for required touches. • Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations. • Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues. During the Day • Complete scheduled owner check-in calls. • Send required emails and text messages. • Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources. • Collect and communicate relevant property updates. • Respond to open work order conversations. • Escalate concerns on the same business day. • Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners. End of Day • Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com. • Update the Owner Churn Board. • Schedule future touches and follow-ups. • Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations. • Prepare the next-day action list. Weekly Close • Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches. • Ensure there are no missed follow-ups. • Complete the CRM documentation self-audit. • Review owner sentiment trends. • Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention. • Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week. Performance Standards & KPIs Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets: • Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day. • Required monthly touch completion: 100%. • Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher. • Undocumented conversations: Zero. • Same-day escalation compliance: 100%. • Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero. • Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving. • Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher. • Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board. Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan. Accountability Standards • Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue. • Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue. • Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue. • Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly. • Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity. • The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation. Qualifications Required • Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable. • 2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field. • Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment. • Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up. • Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with clients and maintain long-term relationships. • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously. • Proactive approach to identifying potential dissatisfaction and escalating concerns appropriately. • Ability to shoot and edit short-form vertical video using a phone and tools such as CapCut, Instagram, or equivalent. • Strong computer skills and ability to work independently with digital communication, CRM, and collaboration tools. • Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment for remote work. Preferred • Previous experience in short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management. • Working knowledge of Streamline VRS, Monday.com, or comparable PMS/CRM platforms. • Experience producing content for Instagram, TikTok, Airbnb, or other property marketing platforms. • Understanding of owner statements, management fees, and short-term rental revenue basics. • Familiarity with the Puerto Vallarta / Nuevo Vallarta vacation rental market. Key Attributes The ideal candidate will be: • Reliable and consistent: Able to perform repetitive activities consistently and accurately. • Calm and professional: Comfortable dealing with frustrated homeowners without becoming defensive or over-promising. • Highly organized: Capable of managing 20–25 daily conversations while maintaining complete follow-up. • Proactive: Identifies potential issues early and takes action before they escalate. • Accountable: Communicates problems honestly and takes ownership of mistakes. • Relationship-oriented: Genuinely interested in understanding homeowners, their properties, and their needs. • Adaptable: Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing priorities without constant supervision. • Strong communicator: Able to communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish. First 90 Days Days 1–30 • Complete access and onboarding for Monday.com, Streamline, RingCentral, and the Owner Engagement Tracker. • Become confident using the required systems and communication tools. • Review the assigned owner portfolio. • Make introductory contact with assigned homeowners. • Complete shadowing and initial training. Days 31–60 • Execute the full daily communication volume of 20–25 owner touches. • Maintain 100% documentation compliance. • Demonstrate consistent follow-up and proactive communication. • Begin independently identifying and escalating owner concerns. Days 61–90 • Achieve overall KPI attainment of 90% or higher. • Own at least one owner retention case from identification through resolution or successful escalation. • Demonstrate consistent owner relationship management and CRM discipline. • Contribute repeatable content formats or communication practices that can be adopted by other Specialists. This job description outlines the primary duties and standards of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be adjusted according to business needs. Workload structure, escalation pathways, and coaching practices will be administered in accordance with applicable company policies and requirements. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/big-bear-vacations-owner-retention-specialist
